messages.recipient_title: Strategy, Customer Excellence, Marketing & Sustainability Director LATAM
messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | CHEP | LATAM Strategy & Sustainability
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Alvarez Romero,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for CHEP, focused on circular supply chains, sustainability strategy, customer value, policy engagement and Latin American growth. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this experience could support regional strategy and sustainability execution. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for CHEP
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Strategy, Customer Excellence, Marketing & Sustainability Director LATAM
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with CHEP's agenda across circular supply chains, sustainability strategy, customer value, policy engagement and Latin American growth. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated execution. For CHEP, his strongest contribution would sit where regional strategy, sustainability commitments, public-policy engagement and customer partnerships require common governance, defensible evidence and executive accountability across markets.
strategic_brief.company_context: CHEP operates through Brambles' global share-and-reuse model, linking customer performance with circular-economy outcomes across complex supply networks. Brambles' 2026 reporting highlights financial resilience, a new 2030 sustainability programme, science-based emissions targets, supplier engagement and a policy framework for circular economy and reusable packaging. In Latin America, growth also requires alignment with customers, regulators, transport ecosystems and local sustainability priorities. This creates an opportunity to connect regional strategy, policy engagement, customer excellence and sustainability evidence more tightly. Leadership with direct experience managing government, ESG and operating interfaces can help turn corporate ambitions into market-level partnerships and measurable outcomes.

opportunities.title: Circular economy policy engagement
opportunities.rationale: Reusable packaging models benefit from supportive policy, customer understanding and regulatory alignment. Structured engagement can help position circular systems as practical infrastructure for efficiency, resilience and environmental value.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can build stakeholder maps and policy engagement plans linking sustainability evidence, customer outcomes and public-sector priorities across selected Latin American markets.

opportunities.title: Customer sustainability value
opportunities.rationale: Strategic customers increasingly expect measurable environmental and operational value from supply-chain partners. Consistent evidence can strengthen commercial relationships and differentiate circular solutions in competitive markets.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can help connect customer narratives to traceable performance evidence, internal owners, partnership commitments and executive reporting that supports both retention and growth.

opportunities.title: Regional partnership governance
opportunities.rationale: Growth across diverse Latin American markets depends on disciplined collaboration with customers, suppliers, public authorities and service partners. Clear governance improves execution and reduces fragmented commitments.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can establish partnership charters, stakeholder registers and cross-functional review routines that connect regional strategy with local implementation, accountability and measurable results.

days_0_30: Map priority markets, customers, policy interfaces and sustainability evidence.
days_31_60: Create stakeholder, customer-value and partnership governance registers.
days_61_90: Pilot integrated policy and sustainability engagement in selected markets.
days_91_180: Embed metrics, lessons learned and executive reporting to support regional scaling.

potential_impact: Clearer sustainability value for strategic customers.
More disciplined partnership execution across LATAM.
background_relevance: Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
ESG, strategic partnerships and corporate-affairs leadership.
Cross-functional coordination with operations, procurement, finance, legal and executive teams.
